item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Esha folds two paper wedges for a craft display. The diagram shows angle $J$ and angle $K$.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims correctly decide which angle is larger by overlaying?

options.A: Match the vertices and align one arm; the free arm of angle $K$ opens farther, so angle $K$ is larger.
options.B: Judge which opening is larger while the vertices stay apart on the desk.
options.C: After the vertices coincide and one arm is aligned, the free arm that sticks out farther belongs to the larger angle.
options.D: The printed letter names $J$ and $K$ alone decide which angle is larger.
